hero.title: 11 Best Beach Clubs in Tulum — The Reddit Guide
hero.dek: Uncover the 11 finest beach clubs in Tulum's Hotel Zone, uniquely vetted and beloved by the Reddit travel community for an authentic experience.

intro.answerFirst: Tulum's beach clubs range from budget-friendly to ultra-luxurious, but the top recommendation for a classic, relaxed experience is Ziggy's Beach Club. Keep in mind that seaweed season (typically May-September) can impact the beach quality, so check conditions before you go.
body: Tulum's beach club scene is a love-it-or-hate-it affair. On one hand: powder-white sand, impossibly blue Caribbean water, and cocktails served on daybeds under palm trees. On the other: minimum spends, influencer swarms, and seaweed that can ruin even the prettiest beach.
We waded through Reddit's hottest takes to find the clubs that actually deliver on the promise — plus one free public beach that might be better than all of them.
intro.methodology: We analyzed 160+ Reddit posts and 800+ comments across r/tulum, r/mexico, r/travel, and r/rivieramaya — spanning 2022 to 2025. Clubs were ranked by recommendation frequency and weighted by value-for-money sentiment.

picks.name: Ziggy's Beach Club
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Ziggy's, attached to The Beach Tulum hotel, is Reddit's consensus chill pick — bohemian Tulum done right, with reasonable minimum spends and consistently the cleanest beach in town.
picks.whatToOrder: Ceviche or guacamole on a daybed with a mezcal cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: Arrive before 11 AM to grab a free-with-minimum daybed without a reservation.

picks.name: Casa Malca
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Casa Malca, the former Pablo Escobar mansion turned Lio Malca art hotel, is the most photographed beach club in Tulum — half art gallery, half lounge.
picks.whatToOrder: A spritz at the pool bar and lunch in the dining room overlooking the sea.
picks.insiderTip: The beach side is small and books up — go for the pool and gardens first.

picks.name: Coco Tulum
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Coco Tulum is the rustic-bohemian end of the spectrum — driftwood swings into the sea, white-on-white aesthetic, a relatively low minimum spend.
picks.whatToOrder: A piña colada in a coconut and lunch at the swing bar.
picks.insiderTip: The famous swings get a queue — go early or stay until sunset for shorter waits.

picks.name: Vagalume
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Vagalume programs serious DJs and is the closest thing Tulum has to a Mykonos-grade daytime party — minimum spends climb fast on event days.
picks.whatToOrder: Bottle service if you're staying late; otherwise a bed-minimum lunch with cocktails.
picks.insiderTip: Check the calendar before booking — DJ days are a different scene than the mellow beach days.

picks.name: La Zebra
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Zebra is the Sunday-salsa institution of Tulum — live music, dance floor on the sand, and a lower-key vibe the rest of the week.
picks.whatToOrder: A mezcal cocktail and ceviche; come back Sunday evening for the salsa night.
picks.insiderTip: Sundays are the must-do night for live salsa; weekdays are a calmer beach lunch.

picks.name: Ahau Tulum
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Ahau is Tulum's yoga-and-tulum-roots spot — the place locals point to when someone says 'old Tulum, before the Instagram era.'
picks.whatToOrder: A fresh juice and a vegetarian lunch from the on-site kitchen.
picks.insiderTip: Quieter and cheaper than the headline beach clubs — best for a low-key lunch day.

picks.name: Papaya Playa Project
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Papaya Playa runs Tulum's biggest full-moon parties and weekend night events — by day a daybed beach, by night an electronic-music venue.
picks.whatToOrder: A daybed lunch by day; a ticket to a full-moon party by night.
picks.insiderTip: Daytime is mellow and worth visiting; nighttime events are a separate ticketed experience entirely.

picks.name: Be Tulum
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Be Tulum's beach club is at the luxury end — high minimums, premium daybeds, and the same spa/architecture aesthetic that made the hotel famous.
picks.whatToOrder: A long lunch on a daybed with a mezcal flight.
picks.insiderTip: Worth it as a one-day splurge if you're not staying at the hotel.

picks.name: Mía Restaurant & Beach Club
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mía leans more on the food than the party, and is one of the few Tulum beach clubs Reddit actively praises for kitchen quality.
picks.whatToOrder: Whole grilled fish and a tropical cocktail at lunch.
picks.insiderTip: Better as a lunch destination than a sundown party stop — the chef is the draw.

picks.name: Hip Hotel Tulum
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Hip Hotel Tulum has one of the lowest minimum spends on the strip, making it a budget-conscious entry point to the beach-club scene.
picks.whatToOrder: A sandwich and a beer to clear the minimum spend.
picks.insiderTip: Easiest beach-club minimum to hit if you're traveling cheap.

picks.name: Taboo Tulum
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Taboo brings a Punta del Este-style premium party — high minimums, glossy lounges, and a more international scenester crowd than the bohemian neighbors.
picks.whatToOrder: Champagne service or a long lunch with sushi from the kitchen.
picks.insiderTip: Most expensive minimum on the strip — match it with a brunch or dinner reservation.

faq.question: How much do Tulum beach clubs cost?
faq.answer: Most beach clubs have a minimum spend of $30–$80 USD per person, which goes toward food and drinks. Premium clubs like Taboo can be $100+. Some smaller spots have no minimum or a low $20 minimum. Drinks are typically $10–$18 USD each.

faq.question: Is the seaweed bad in Tulum?
faq.answer: Sargassum seaweed is a real issue in Tulum, especially from May through September. Beach clubs clean their areas daily, so they're usually better than public beaches. January through April tends to have the least seaweed. Check recent Reddit posts or iSeahorse before your trip for current conditions.

faq.question: What is the best beach club in Tulum for a chill day?
faq.answer: Ziggy's, Coco Tulum, and Hip Hotel are the most recommended for a relaxed, bohemian vibe without the party scene. For families or couples wanting peace, these are consistently the top Reddit picks.

faq.question: Are Tulum beach clubs overpriced?
faq.answer: Many Redditors say yes — Tulum has gotten expensive compared to a few years ago. However, compared to beach clubs in Mykonos or Ibiza, it's still more affordable. The key is managing expectations: know the minimum spend before you go, and choose clubs that match your budget and vibe.

faq.question: What's the difference between 'minimum spend' and 'entry fee' at Tulum beach clubs?
faq.answer: A 'minimum spend' means you pay nothing to enter, but you must spend a set amount on food and drinks. Any spending contributes to this total. An 'entry fee,' common at places like Papaya Playa Project for night events, is a separate charge just to get in, and often does not include any credit towards food or beverages.

faq.question: Are Tulum beach clubs kid-friendly?
faq.answer: While many beach clubs welcome children, the 'kid-friendly' level varies. Places like Ziggy's Beach Club and La Zebra are generally more accommodating with families, offering a relaxed atmosphere and good food. High-energy party spots like Taboo Tulum or late-night events at Papaya Playa Project are typically geared towards adults.

faq.question: Which Tulum beach clubs are best for a quieter, more relaxed experience?
faq.answer: For a truly tranquil day, consider starting your visit early in the morning at almost any club, as the crowds typically arrive later. Specifically, Ziggy's Beach Club consistently receives high marks for its laid-back atmosphere and excellent service, making it perfect for relaxation. Coco Tulum also offers a charmingly rustic and serene setting, ideal for unwinding.

faq.question: How much does a day at a Tulum beach club typically cost?
faq.answer: The cost can vary significantly based on the club and your spending habits. Budget-friendly options like Hip Hotel Tulum might have a minimum spend of $20-$30. Mid-range clubs like Ziggy's Beach Club or La Zebra often range from $40-$60. Luxury clubs such as Be Tulum or Taboo Tulum can have minimums from $60 up to $150+, plus any extra purchases and tips.

faq.question: Are there any Tulum beach clubs known for live music or entertainment?
faq.answer: Absolutely! La Zebra is renowned for its vibrant Sunday salsa nights, drawing enthusiastic dancers and spectators. Vagalume frequently hosts acclaimed DJs, especially transitioning from day to night. And of course, Papaya Playa Project is the go-to for major full moon parties and weekend electronic music events, establishing itself as a premier nightlife destination.
